name: Yume ka Utsutsu ka Matryoshka
original_name: 夢か現かマトリョーシカ
source:
This is the debut title by Effordomsoft crown. Mamoru lives on the island of Shinonoshima, enjoying every moment with his osananajimi Miyako and close friends Isuka, Shiori, Nagi, Aoi and Kazushige. Their time together is irreplaceable to him and he believed that it would continue forever. However, he did not know he was about to fall into the abyss of despair.

He fell into a deep sleep due to a certain incident, and when he woke up, no one else remained except Miyako. Not wanting him to remain in sorrow, she told him about a 'tradition' passed down through generations. On the 100th night after the loss of their precious ones, if they are able to gather memories deeply connected with them and offer them to the island's protective god Wadatsumi, then it might bring their lost ones back. They prepared for the ceremony while clinging on to the belief that it will work. 

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Effordomsoft crown的出道作品。守住在信之岛上，与青梅竹马都和亲密的朋友伊香、诗织、凪、葵以及和繁一起享受着每一刻。他们的相处时光对他来说是无可替代的，他相信这会永远持续下去。然而，他不知道自己即将坠入绝望的深渊。因为某个事件，他陷入了深深的沉睡，当他醒来时，除了都以外已经没有人了。不想让他沉浸在悲伤中的她，告诉了他一个世代相传的“传统”。在失去珍贵之人后的第100个夜晚，如果能收集与他们紧密相连的记忆，并将其献给岛屿的守护神绵津见，就有可能将失去的人带回来。他们坚信仪式会奏效，为此做着准备。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/09/27/september-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
